scope: Pediatric outpatient/home medication regimens after ED/urgent-care evaluation
safety_rules: Select regimen by diagnosis; never copy a dose across indications.
Liquid mL may be generated only from an explicitly verified exact product concentration.
Apply source adult/per-dose and daily caps.
Weight basis is explicit. Do not substitute actual/ideal/adjusted weight silently.
Marked obesity requires drug-specific review when evidence is limited; adult maximums still apply when the source specifies them.
Renal/hepatic impairment, allergy, drug interactions, inability to tolerate oral treatment, red flags and age restrictions may override outpatient treatment.

obesity_policy.rule: For patients <18 years and <40 kg, weight-based dosing is generally used. At >=40 kg, continue weight-based dosing unless it exceeds the recommended adult dose for the indication. Drug-specific PK/weight-scalar evidence supersedes this general rule.
obesity_policy.explicit_exception: RCH oral paracetamol is dosed on ideal body weight.
obesity_policy.note: Do not assign ideal or adjusted body weight to other outpatient drugs without drug-specific evidence.
